purpose: Declarative contract for the V2 minimum MCP collection. It fixes 0..N server / 0..N tool semantics, source identity, cross-server duplicate names, independent enable/disable, local failure isolation, revocation and disconnect handling. It contains no secrets and no fixed runtime port; ports are allocated at run time after a loopback bind precheck and recorded in the run manifest.

servers.emptySetMeaning: no servers configured -> no MCP tools contributed; the run still proceeds
servers.source: extensions_config.json:mcpServers object keyed by server id
forbiddenDesigns: database constrained to a single MCP row
a single mcpClient field that can hold only one server
per-tool Controller/DTO branches keyed on a fixed tool name

tools.discovery: each enabled server is discovered independently
tools.perServerIsolation: one server failing discovery or a call must not remove or block tools from other servers
tools.sourceIdentity: every tool carries its producing server name via adapter tagging plus the <server>_ prefix when tool_name_prefix=true

prefix.unprefixedNote: servers whose tools already carry a stable namespace may set false; source routing must not infer the server from the visible name prefix

crossServerDuplicateName.requirement: two servers may both expose get_status; they remain distinct tools because identity includes the server source
crossServerDuplicateName.negativeIf: a single global tool registry collapses the two into one entry, or calling one server's get_status resolves the other server

agentSelection.noneMeaning: all enabled MCP installations are selectable
agentSelection.listMeaning: only the listed installation ids are selectable
agentSelection.negativeIf: null is treated as none, or [] is treated as all

enableDisable.isolation: disabling one server leaves sibling servers enabled and callable
enableDisable.hook: config change plus MCP tools cache reset so next discovery sees the new state

transport.v2L2: loopback HTTP transport between the runner and an independent local test MCP process

credentials.rule: records only existence or a CredentialRef; secret values are never stored in this fixture or emitted in evidence

timeouts.scope: per server; a slow or hung server must not block the others

allowlist.nature: soft routing preference overrides per original tool name; not a hard capability boundary
allowlist.note: stdio API registration additionally enforces a command allowlist (npx/uvx) at the HTTP boundary

revocation.expected: subsequent call is refused; no fallback to a synthetic or cached result

disconnect.trigger: explicit MCP 'Connection closed' or AnyIO closed-stream error
disconnect.expected: the failing call surfaces its original error and is not replayed automatically; a later explicit retry may establish a fresh session; unknown result must not be reported as success

servers.endpointRef: runtime-allocated; recorded in run manifest; never hardcoded in this fixture
runtime-allocated; recorded in run manifest; never hardcoded in this fixture

requiredContractCases.assertion: at least 2 servers are configured and both are discovered
each server exposes at least 2 tools; a 0-tool server is allowed and must not fail discovery of siblings
v2-reporting.get_status and v2-region.get_status remain distinct and resolve to their own server
disabling v2-region does not affect v2-reporting calls
a failed v2-region leaves v2-reporting fully callable
at least one tool from each server is actually invoked over the real transport
each call records the producing server id and the transport
a disabled or uncredentialed server refuses the call without fallback
